title: Sanctions for violations.
bodyText: An owner or its employee or authorized representative shall be subject to sanctions pursuant to this chapter for the violation of any provision of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§431:9A-175]  Sanctions for violations.  An owner or its employee or authorized representative shall be subject to sanctions pursuant to this chapter for the violation of any provision of this chapter. [L 2019, c 284, pt of §2]
